title: How Similar Are Grokipedia and Wikipedia? A Multi-Dimensional Textual and Structural Comparison
reasoning: The paper specifically includes 'religion and ideologies' as one of the core topical domains used to evaluate and benchmark the differences between Grokipedia and Wikipedia. It identifies religion as a domain with significant ideological divergence and rightward bias shifts, and discusses the results in terms of an 'epistemological divide' between AI-generated and human-edited knowledge systems.
